answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 59857 Country: India Title: Confirmation for Sadka Question: I want confirm that if we invite madrasa students for lunch at home, can we ask them for tilawat-e-Quran or not. Actually we heard that if we invite madrasa students to offer lunch for sadaqah/ Allah’s sake we should not ask them for tilawat-e-Quran as that would be an exchange offer. Answer ID: 59857 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 928/928/M=09/1436) One should avoid feeding those who recite the holy Quran after they finish as it resembles compensation. In case you invite the students at your home for feeding them then you should not ask them to recite the holy Quran. However, one should recite the holy Quran oneself and should not invite the students to recite the Quran collectively. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
